title: 8th HPP-NL Workshop (History and Philosophy of Physics in the Netherlands)
speaker: Caspar Jacobs, Mor Lumbroso, Luca Forgiarini, Sanne Vergouwen, Thijs Latten, Klaas Landsman
description: Talks by NL-based historians and philosophers of physics, closing with a mock fishbowl debate on the thesis “History of Physics is irrelevant for Philosophy of Physics”, moderated by Hieke Huistra, with Niels Martens as (mock) proponent and Jeroen van Dongen as opponent. Walk-in from 12:30, optional dinner afterwards. Free, but registration is required (see hpp-nl.nl).
